**Test build for Nexo 1.3**: a small update to test.2. Everyone else stays on v1.2.0.

> **Hosts:** no server update needed; servers on v1.3.0-test.2 work with this build (banners need test.2 or later).

## Changes

- **Settings:** **Language & time** now has a translate icon instead of a globe.

Everything from test.1 and test.2 is still here: the new look, themes and app icons, profile banners, Nexo in
Portuguese, the 12/24-hour clock and the new sound effects.

## What to test

The same as test.2: Portuguese, banners, the clock and the new sounds. Send a screenshot of anything that looks
wrong.

## Leaving test builds

Already on a test build? Nothing to do: Nexo updates itself. To go back to the regular releases:
**Settings → App → Updates → Leave test builds**, then restart Nexo.
